subject: Slate compile & sign-off: Q3 leadership highlights + OKR snapshots
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slate compile & sign-off: Q3 leadership highlights + OKR snapshots

Team —

I need to assemble the Q3 leadership slate for the upcoming board/QBR run (goal: concise, executive-first). Please do the following by EOD Thursday (08/23):
- One slide per org for OKR snapshot (status, 2x highlights, 1 blocker) — keep to a single visual.
- Any metric charts should be export-ready PNGs (high res).
- Label slides with your initials and version (e.g., MINA_infra_v2).

I've attached the master template as a starting point. I will merge everything into a consolidated deck, do a copy edit pass Friday morning, and circulate the final for sign-off. If you have anything that absolutely must be discussed in the meeting, flag it inline.

Attachment: SLATE_MASTER_TEMPLATE.pptx (pptx)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slate compile & sign-off: Q3 leadership highlights + OKR snapshots

Ben — thanks for the heads up. Attached my infra OKR slide and a high-res PNG of the GPU cost trend we should pull into the cost section. Notes:
- The OKR slide calls out the GPU-cost target (Q3 baseline = $0.62/token) and the mitigation plan (quantization pilot + burst routing).
- I added a small note about the audit timeline for Private deployments (legal asked to surface this).

If you want the underlying table, I can attach a CSV — otherwise the PNG should be sufficient for the slide.

Attachments: infra-okrs-slide-v2.pptx, infra-kpi-chart.png

Ben / all —

Two asks from finance and investor relations before we finalize:
1) Can someone confirm the revenue run-rate and ARR translation for the top-line slide? I'd like a one-line bulleted metric (ARR = $XXm) rather than ranges.
2) For the cost slide (Mina), can we include a 6-month trend and call out the one-time infra spend in June separately?

Amy — looping you for visibility on the topline number; if you want to drop a redline, please do so in Drive (link below).

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Slate-2028

Two operational asks:
- If there are copy-only edits (typo, one-line clarification), I suggest we apply them directly and not recirculate to shorten the loop. Anything content-significant should be an explicit reply-all with a requested change.
- Please add any formal sign-off (Name + Role) to the signoff-log.csv in the Drive once you approve v3. I'll attach v3 here for offline review.

Attachment: consolidated-slate-v3.pptx, signoff-log.csv

Subject: Final: Consolidated slate (v4) + sign-off request

Attached is consolidated-slate-final-v4.pptx. I incorporated:
- Mina's infra slide + the 6-month trend (with a separate note on June one-time spend).
- Jonas's roadmap edits.
- One-line ARR metric per Laura's ask (ARR = $27.4M).

Please do the following by EOD Friday (08/24):
- Add a row to signoff-log.csv (Name | Role | Approve Y/N | Timestamp).
- If you want a content-level change, reply-all with the requested change and rationale. Minor copy edits are ok to push without recirculation.

I've also pasted a short sign-off checklist inside the deck notes (page 1). If I don't see any content objections, I'll mark this as sent to the board ops and upload the package to the portal on Monday.

Attachments: consolidated-slate-final-v4.pptx

Thanks — Ben
